up: Retrieve the first 200 metabolism records where the enzyme is UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 1A10 (UGT1A10). For each record, include: the canonical SMILES of the substrate compound, the preferred name of the substrate compound, the preferred name of the parent compound (drug), the metabolic conversion description (met_conversion), the pathway key (pathway_key), and the organism. Join the metabolism table with compound_structures and molecule_dictionary to get structure and names. Filter by enzyme name containing 'UGT1A10' or 'UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 1A10'. Order by met_id and limit to 200 rows.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles AS substrate_structure, md_sub.pref_name AS substrate_name, md_parent.pref_name AS parent_compound_name, m.met_conversion AS metabolic_conversion, m.pathway_key AS pathway, m.organism FROM metabolism m JOIN compound_records cr_sub ON m.substrate_record_id = cr_sub.record_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr_sub.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md_sub ON cr_sub.molregno = md_sub.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr_parent ON m.drug_record_id = cr_parent.record_id LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md_parent ON cr_parent.molregno = md_parent.molregno WHERE m.enzyme_name LIKE '%UGT1A10%' ORDER BY m.met_id LIMIT 200
